detects: the extension activates, captures correctly and reports nothing — writeCaptureState always returns early, so .promptster/editor-capture.json is never created and promptster doctor reads the extension as 'installed but never activated'
why: Subtle, and the exact shape of the bug that costs a hiring decision. Capture itself is fine, so an agent checking 'did the extension activate and register its commands' sees a clean run. The missing file makes a working session indistinguishable from a candidate who opened no files. It is caught only by reading back the capture state, which is what the skill says to do and what a pixel-checking agent skips.
